title: Taklif qilish, rozi bo‘lish va rad etish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida odamni xushmuomalalik bilan taklif qilasiz, taklifni ishtiyoq bilan qabul qilasiz, sabab keltirib odob bilan rad etasiz va boshqa vaqtni taklif qilasiz.

scenes.title: Taklif qilish va rad etish
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we will learn how to invite people, how to say yes, and how to say no politely.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda hozirgi davomli zamonni o‘rgandik, ya’ni hozir nima bo‘layotganini aytishni. Bugun u ham kerak bo‘ladi. Chunki biror kishini taklif qilganda “bugun kechqurun biror ishingiz bormi?” deb so‘raymiz. Dars oxirida odamni taklif qilasiz, taklifni qabul qilasiz, sabab bilan xushmuomala rad etasiz va boshqa vaqt taklif qilasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun odamlarni taklif qilishni, rozi bo‘lishni va xushmuomalalik bilan rad etishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Would you like to...?
board: Would you like to come to dinner?

examples.t: Would you like to come to dinner?

scenes.say: Would you like to come to dinner? Would you like some tea? Would you like to join us?
scenes.say_native: Eng xushmuomala taklif shakli: Would you like to, keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli. Would you like to come to dinner? Kechki ovqatga kelishni xohlaysizmi? Ot bilan ham ishlatiladi: Would you like some tea? Choy xohlaysizmi? Bu shakl do you like dan farq qiladi. Do you like tea, choy yoqadimi, degan ma’no beradi, would you like esa hozirgi taklif. Notanish yoki katta odamlar bilan aynan shuni ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Kechki ovqatga kelishni xohlaysizmi? Choy xohlaysizmi? Bizga qo‘shilishni xohlaysizmi?

scenes.title: Do you want to va Are you free?
board: Do you want to see a film? (do‘stlarga)
scenes.say: Do you want to see a film? Are you free on Saturday? Are you doing anything tonight? Fancy a coffee?
scenes.say_native: Do‘stlar orasida soddaroq shakl ham bor: Do you want to see a film? Taklifdan oldin vaqtni tekshirish uchun: Are you free on Saturday? yoki hozirgi davomli bilan: Are you doing anything tonight? Bunda siz bugun kechqurunga biror reja borligini so‘rayapsiz. Britaniyada juda erkin: Fancy a coffee? Bu qisqa ibora “qahva ichamizmi?” degan ma’noda. Rasmiy joyda esa Would you like ni ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Film ko‘rishni xohlaysanmi? Shanba kuni bo‘shmisan? Bugun kechqurun biror ishing bormi? Qahva ichamizmi?

scenes.title: Birgalikda taklif: Let's, How about, Shall we

examples.t: How about going for a walk?
Why don't we have lunch together?

scenes.say: Let's go to the park. How about a walk? Why don't we have lunch together? Shall we start?
scenes.say_native: Birgalikda biror ish qilishni taklif qilish uchun to‘rtta qolip bor. Let’s va fe’l: Let’s go to the park, ya’ni boraylik. How about, ot yoki -ing bilan: How about a walk? How about going for a walk? Why don’t we va fe’l: Why don’t we have lunch together? Britaniyada Shall we ham bor: Shall we start? Bularning hammasi “mana shuni qilaylik” degan ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Parkka boraylik. Sayr qilsak-chi? Birga tushlik qilsak-chi? Boshlaymizmi?

scenes.title: Taklifdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Would you like go with us?
✗ Do you like to come tonight?
✓ Would you like to go? Do you want to come? Let's go.
scenes.say: Not: would you like go. Say: would you like to go. Not: let's to go. Say: let's go.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: would you like go. Would you like dan keyin to kerak: would you like to go. Ikkinchisi: do you like to come tonight. Like “yoqtirmoq”, bu taklif emas, siz do you want to yoki would you like to deng. Uchinchisi: let’s to go yoki let’s going. Let’s dan keyin faqat oddiy fe’l, to ham -ing ham yo‘q. Ekrandagi to‘g‘ri gaplarni baland ovozda takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: Would you like go emas, would you like to go deng. Let's to go emas, let's go deng.

scenes.title: Taklif tuzing
board: 2) come to my house on Friday
3) a film tonight (Are you free / Do you want to...?)
4) go for a walk (Let's / How about...?)
scenes.say: Make an invitation for each. Tea. My house on Friday. A film tonight. A walk.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir uchun taklif tuzing. Birinchi: choy, would you like bilan. Ikkinchi: juma kuni uyimga kelish, would you like to bilan. Uchinchi: bugun kechqurun film, do you want to yoki are you free bilan. To‘rtinchi: sayr, let’s yoki how about bilan. Har bir taklifni xushmuomala ohangda baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har biri uchun taklif tuzing. Choy. Juma kuni uyimga. Bugun film. Sayr.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Would you like to come to my house on Friday?
3) Do you want to see a film tonight?
4) Let's go for a walk. / How about a walk?
scenes.say: Would you like some tea? Would you like to come to my house on Friday? Do you want to see a film tonight? Let's go for a walk.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Would you like some tea? Ikkinchi: Would you like to come to my house on Friday? Uchinchi: Do you want to see a film tonight? Yoki Are you free tonight? Do you want to see a film? To‘rtinchi: Let’s go for a walk yoki How about a walk? Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, bu qoliplardan chiqmasa bo‘ldi. Ularni oldinma-keyin takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: Choy xohlaysizmi? Juma kuni uyimga kelishni xohlaysizmi? Bugun kechqurun film ko‘rishni xohlaysanmi? Sayr qilaylik.

scenes.title: Ishtiyoq bilan rozi bo‘lish
scenes.say: I'd love to! That sounds great! Sure, why not? Thanks for inviting me!
scenes.say_native: Taklifni qabul qilish uchun eng yaxshi ibora: I’d love to, bu “jonim bilan, xursandman” degani. Yana: That sounds great, ajoyib eshitilyapti, Good idea, yaxshi fikr, Sure, why not, albatta, nega bo‘lmasin. Oxirida minnatdorchilik bildiring: Thanks for inviting me. Inglizlar ishtiyoqni ovoz bilan ko‘rsatishadi. Faqat “OK” yoki “Fine” desangiz, xursand emasdek tuyuladi, garchi aslida xursand bo‘lsangiz ham.
scenes.say_uz: Jonim bilan! Ajoyib eshitilyapti! Albatta, nega bo‘lmasin? Taklif uchun rahmat!

scenes.title: Rozi bo‘lgandan keyin
board: Where is it? / Where shall we meet?
scenes.say: What time does it start? Where shall we meet? Shall I bring something? See you on Saturday!
scenes.say_native: Rozi bo‘lgandan keyin tafsilotlarni so‘rang, shunda qiziqishingiz ko‘rinadi. What time does it start? Qachon boshlanadi? Where shall we meet? Qayerda uchrashamiz? Shall I bring something? Biror narsa olib kelaymi? Oxirida: See you on Saturday! Shanba kuni ko‘rishamiz. Shall I ham Britaniya ohangidagi odobli so‘z. Yaqin do‘stlar orasida Can I bring something? ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say_uz: Soat nechada boshlanadi? Qayerda uchrashamiz? Biror narsa olib kelaymi? Shanba kuni ko‘rishamiz!

scenes.title: Taklifga javob: Yes, please va No, thank you
board: Would you like some tea? – Yes, please.
Would you like some tea? – No, thank you.
✗ Yes, I would like. / ✗ No, I don't want.
scenes.say: Would you like some tea? Yes, please. Would you like some more? No, thank you, I'm fine.
scenes.say_native: Narsa taklif qilinganda, masalan choy, javob juda qisqa: Yes, please yoki No, thank you. Please ni unutmang, “Yes” yolg‘iz o‘zi qo‘pol tuyuladi. Rad etayotganda ham thank you deb qo‘shing: No, thank you, I’m fine. Ba’zan o‘zbek tilidan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilib, “Yes, I want” yoki “No, I don’t want” deyishadi. Bu juda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri va qo‘pol eshitiladi. Siz yuqoridagi ikki ibora bilan cheklaning.
scenes.say_uz: Choy xohlaysizmi? Ha, iltimos. Yana xohlaysizmi? Yo‘q, rahmat, men yaxshiman.

scenes.title: Rozilikdagi xatolar
board: ✓ Yes, I'd love to! / Sure, thanks!
scenes.say: Not: yes, I would like. Say: I'd love to. Not: I come. Say: I'd love to come.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: Yes, I would like. Bu to‘liq javob emas, would like dan keyin nima kerakligini aytmadingiz. To‘g‘risi: Yes, I’d love to, to oxirida qoladi. Ikkinchisi: Yes, I want yoki shunchaki OK, juda quruq. Uchinchisi: Yes, I come. Bu zamon xato, siz kelishga rozi ekaningizni aytyapsiz, shuning uchun I’d love to come. Doim to bilan tugating va ohangingiz quvnoq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Yes, I would like emas, Yes, I'd love to deng. I come emas, I'd love to come deng.

scenes.title: Qabul qiling
board: 1) Would you like to come to dinner?
2) Do you want to play football?
scenes.say: Accept each invitation with enthusiasm.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta taklifni quvonch bilan qabul qiling. Birinchi: kechki ovqatga kelishni xohlaysizmi? Ikkinchi: futbol o‘ynashni xohlaysanmi? Uchinchi: qahva ichsak-chi? To‘rtinchi: parkka boraylik. Har biriga turli javob bering: I’d love to, Sure why not, Good idea, That sounds great. Ovoz ohangi quvnoq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir taklifni ishtiyoq bilan qabul qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I'd love to! Thanks for inviting me.
scenes.say: I'd love to! Thanks for inviting me. Sure, why not? Good idea, thanks! That sounds great!
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: I’d love to, thanks for inviting me. Ikkinchi: Sure, why not? Uchinchi: Good idea, thanks. To‘rtinchi: That sounds great. Siz boshqa variantni tanlagan bo‘lishingiz mumkin, hammasi to‘g‘ri, agar ohang xursandchilikni bildirsa. Bitta iborani har safar takrorlamang, turli iboralardan foydalansangiz nutqingiz boy chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Jonim bilan! Taklif uchun rahmat. Albatta, nega bo‘lmasin? Yaxshi fikr, rahmat! Ajoyib eshitilyapti!

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ishtiyoq ohangi
scenes.say: I'd love to! That sounds great! Thanks so much!
scenes.say_native: Ishtiyoq faqat so‘zda emas, ovozda ham bo‘ladi. I’d love to ifodasida urg‘u love so‘ziga tushadi va ovoz ko‘tarilib, keyin pasayadi. That sounds great da great so‘zi balandroq va cho‘ziqroq aytiladi. Agar tekis ovozda “I’d love to” desangiz, ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchi sizning xursand emasligingizni o‘ylashi mumkin. I’d so‘zi qisqa, “ayd” kabi eshitiladi. Ishtiyoqni biroz oshirib ayting, bu odatiy.
scenes.say_uz: Jonim bilan! Ajoyib eshitilyapti! Katta rahmat!

scenes.title: Qaysi biri yaxshiroq?
board: 1) A: Fine.   B: I'd love to!
2) A: Yes, I would like.   B: Yes, I'd love to.
3) A: OK.   B: That sounds great!
4) A: Yes, I want.   B: Sure, why not?
scenes.say: Which answer is better? A or B? One, two, three, four.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta juftlikda qaysi javob taklifga yaxshiroq mos, A yoki B? Qaysi biri ishtiyoqli, qaysi biri grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri va tabiiy ekanini o‘ylab ko‘ring. Keyin yaxshi variantni baland ovozda, mos ohangda ayting. Bu mashqda mukammal talaffuz emas, ishtiyoq va to‘g‘rilik muhim.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi javob yaxshiroq? A yoki B? Bir, ikki, uch, to‘rt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: B in every case. I'd love to! Yes, I'd love to. That sounds great! Sure, why not?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. To‘rttasida ham B. Birinchi: I’d love to quvonchni bildiradi, Fine esa quruq. Ikkinchi: yes, I would like to‘liq emas, yes, I’d love to to‘g‘ri. Uchinchi: OK sovuq, That sounds great iliq. To‘rtinchi: yes, I want qo‘pol, Sure, why not yoqimli. Shu to‘rtta ibora bilan taklifga ishonchli javob berasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Hammasida B. Jonim bilan! Ha, jonim bilan. Ajoyib eshitilyapti! Albatta, nega bo‘lmasin?

scenes.title: Dialog: tug‘ilgan kunga taklif
board: Tom: Are you free on Saturday?
Tom: It's my birthday. Would you like to come?
scenes.say: Hi, Lisa. Are you free on Saturday? I think so. Why? It's my birthday and I'm having a small party at home. Would you like to come? I'd love to! What time does it start? At seven. Great. Shall I bring something? Just yourself!
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Tom Lisani tug‘ilgan kuniga taklif qiladi. Avval u Lisaning bo‘shligini so‘raydi, keyin taklif qiladi. Lisa quvonch bilan rozi bo‘ladi va tafsilotlarni so‘raydi. E’tibor bering, Tom birdan taklif qilmadi, avval savol bilan tayyorladi. Savollarni o‘qib chiqing va dialogni tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Liza. Shanba kuni bo‘shmisan? Shunday deb o‘ylayman. Nima uchun? Mening tug‘ilgan kunim, uyda kichik ziyofat qilyapman. Kelishni xohlaysanmi? Jonim bilan! Soat nechada boshlanadi? Yettida. Ajoyib. Biror narsa olib kelaymi? Faqat o‘zing kel!

scenes.title: Dialog haqida savollar
scenes.say: Four questions about Tom and Lisa.
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: ziyofat qachon? Ikkinchi: u nima munosabati bilan? Uchinchi: soat nechada boshlanadi? To‘rtinchi: Lisa nima olib kelishi kerak? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Eslay olmasangiz, dialogni yana bir marta diqqat bilan tinglang va javobingizni tekshiring.
scenes.say_uz: Tom va Liza haqida to‘rtta savol.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: The party is on Saturday. It is Tom's birthday. It starts at seven. Lisa doesn't have to bring anything.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ziyofat shanba kuni, on Saturday. Bu Tomning tug‘ilgan kuni, it’s Tom’s birthday. U yettida boshlanadi, at seven. Lisa hech narsa olib kelishi shart emas, bu have to inkor shakli, o‘tgan darslarda o‘rgandik: shart emas. Just yourself iborasi “faqat o‘zing kel” degan ma’noni beradi. Bu tabiiy va iliq javob.
scenes.say_uz: Ziyofat shanba kuni. Bu Tomning tug‘ilgan kuni. U yettida boshlanadi. Lizaga hech narsa olib kelish shart emas.

scenes.title: Xushmuomala rad etish formulasi
board: 2) I'm afraid I can't. / I can't make it.

examples.t: I'd love to, but I'm busy.

scenes.say: Thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't. I have to work. Sorry!
scenes.say_native: Rad etishning to‘rt qadamli formulasi. Birinchi: minnatdorchilik yoki quvonch: Thanks for asking yoki I’d love to, but. Ikkinchi: yumshoq rad: I’m afraid I can’t, afsuski, qila olmayman, yoki I can’t make it. Uchinchi: qisqa sabab. To‘rtinchi: boshqa vaqt yoki kechirim. Bu tartib rad etishni qo‘pol emas, hurmatli qiladi. Just “No” yoki “I can’t” desangiz, uzr so‘ramasdan yuz o‘girgandek tuyuladi.
scenes.say_uz: Taklif uchun rahmat, afsuski, qila olmayman. Ishlashim kerak. Kechirasiz!

scenes.title: Sabab keltirish
board: I have to + verb: I have to work.
I'm busy / tired / out of town

examples.t: I have to finish a report.
I'm meeting my aunt on Saturday.

scenes.say: I have to finish a report. I'm meeting my aunt. I'm tired. I already have plans.
scenes.say_native: Sabab sodda va rost bo‘lsin. Birinchi usul: I have to va fe’l, bu o‘tgan darsda o‘rgangan majburiyat: I have to finish a report. Ikkinchi usul: hozirgi davomli bilan oldindan kelishilgan reja: I’m meeting my aunt on Saturday. Uchinchi: I’m busy, I’m tired. To‘rtinchi: I already have plans. Uzun hikoya kerak emas. Bir qisqa sabab yetarli, ortiqcha tushuntirish ham shubhali eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni tugatishim kerak. Shanba kuni xolam bilan uchrashyapman. Charchaganman. Mening allaqachon rejam bor.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha odob va inglizcha ochiqlik
board: Ammo: yolg‘on bahona emas, haqiqiy sabab
scenes.say: A short reason is enough. Don't worry. A polite no is normal.
scenes.say_native: Madaniy farq. O‘zbek madaniyatida taklifni rad etish ba’zan noqulay, ko‘pincha uzoq uzr yoki “ko‘ramiz” deyiladi. Ingliz tilida esa qisqa va aniq rad javobi normal va hurmatsizlik emas. Muhimi, aniqlik: we’ll see, ya’ni “ko‘ramiz”, inglizlarga ko‘pincha noaniq tuyuladi, ular javobni kutib turadi. Shuning uchun yo rozi bo‘ling, yo qisqa sabab bilan rad eting. Kerak bo‘lsa, boshqa vaqt taklif qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa sabab yetarli. Xavotir olmang. Xushmuomala rad etish normal holat.

scenes.title: Rad etishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I can't because I'm have a meeting.
✓ I'm afraid I can't. I'm having a meeting.
scenes.say: Not: no, I don't want. Say: I'm afraid I can't. Not: I'm have a meeting. Say: I have a meeting.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: No, I don’t want. Bu juda qo‘pol, “xohlamayman” deb eshitiladi. Buning o‘rniga I’m afraid I can’t. Ikkinchisi: sababsiz qisqa I can’t, bu sovuq. Sabab qo‘shing. Uchinchisi: I’m have a meeting. Bunda am va have birga ketgan. To‘g‘risi: I have a meeting yoki I’m having a meeting. Gap tuzayotganda bitta yordamchi fe’l tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: No, I don't want emas, I'm afraid I can't deng. I'm have a meeting emas, I have a meeting deng.

scenes.title: Xushmuomala rad eting
board: 1) Cinema tonight — you have to study.
2) Dinner on Friday — you're meeting your aunt.
4) Party next week — you're out of town.
scenes.say: Refuse politely. Give a reason. One, two, three, four.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir taklifni xushmuomala rad eting va sabab ayting. Birinchi: bugun kechqurun kino, siz o‘qishingiz kerak. Ikkinchi: juma kuni kechki ovqat, siz xolangiz bilan uchrashyapsiz. Uchinchi: yakshanba futbol, siz charchagansiz. To‘rtinchi: kelasi hafta ziyofat, siz shahar tashqarisidasiz. Formula: minnatdorchilik, rad, sabab.
scenes.say_uz: Xushmuomala rad eting va sabab ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Thanks, but I'm afraid I can't. I have to study.
2) I'd love to, but I'm meeting my aunt.
3) Sorry, I can't make it. I'm tired.
4) I'm afraid I can't. I'm out of town.
scenes.say: Thanks, but I'm afraid I can't. I have to study. I'd love to, but I'm meeting my aunt. Sorry, I can't make it. I'm tired. I'm afraid I can't. I'm out of town.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: Thanks, but I’m afraid I can’t, I have to study. Ikkinchi: I’d love to, but I’m meeting my aunt. Uchinchi: Sorry, I can’t make it, I’m tired. To‘rtinchi: I’m afraid I can’t, I’m out of town. Hammasida avval quvonch yoki minnatdorchilik, keyin rad, keyin sabab. Bu tartib sizga ishonch beradi, shuning uchun yodlab oling.
scenes.say_uz: Rahmat, afsuski, qila olmayman. O‘qishim kerak. Jonim bilan, lekin xolam bilan uchrashyapman. Kechirasiz, kela olmayman. Charchaganman. Afsuski, qila olmayman. Shahar tashqarisidaman.

scenes.title: Dialog: rad etish va yangi vaqt
board: Anna: Do you want to see a film tonight?
Omar: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't.
Omar: I have to finish a report.
scenes.say: Do you want to see a film tonight, Omar? I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't. I have to finish a report for work. Oh, that's a pity. How about tomorrow evening? Tomorrow's fine. Let's meet at the cinema at six. Perfect. See you there!
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Anna Omarni kinoga taklif qiladi. Omar rad etadi, lekin xushmuomala: avval quvonch, keyin rad, keyin sabab. Keyin boshqa vaqt taklif qiladi va ular kelishib olishadi. Rad etish suhbatni tugatmadi, aksincha, yangi reja paydo bo‘ldi. Savollarni o‘qib, dialogni tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Omar, bugun kechqurun film ko‘rishni xohlaysanmi? Jonim bilan, lekin afsuski, qila olmayman. Ish uchun hisobotni tugatishim kerak. Afsus. Ertaga kechqurun-chi? Ertaga bo‘ladi. Soat oltida kinoteatrda uchrashaylik. Zo‘r. U yerda ko‘rishamiz!

scenes.title: Anna va Omar haqida savollar
board: 1) What does Anna invite Omar to do?
4) Where and when do they meet?
scenes.say: Four questions about Anna and Omar.
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Anna Omarni nimaga taklif qiladi? Ikkinchi: Omar nima uchun bugun bora olmaydi? Uchinchi: Omar nimani taklif qiladi? To‘rtinchi: ular qayerda va qachon uchrashadi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Agar eslay olmasangiz, dialogni yana bir marta diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Anna va Omar haqida to‘rtta savol.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) He has to finish a report.
scenes.say: Anna invites Omar to see a film. Omar has to finish a report. He suggests tomorrow evening. They meet at the cinema at six.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Anna Omarni film ko‘rishga taklif qiladi, to see a film. Omar hisobotni tugatishi kerak, he has to finish a report. U ertaga kechqurunni taklif qiladi, tomorrow evening. Ular soat oltida kinoteatrda uchrashadi, at the cinema at six. Dialogdagi Oh, that’s a pity iborasi afsus bildiradi, rad etilgan odamni tinchlantiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Anna Omarni film ko‘rishga taklif qiladi. Omar hisobotni tugatishi kerak. U ertaga kechqurunni taklif qiladi. Ular soat oltida kinoteatrda uchrashadi.

scenes.title: Boshqa vaqt taklif qilish
board: Are you free on Sunday instead?
Maybe another time. / Let's do it next week.
scenes.say: How about tomorrow? Are you free on Sunday instead? Can we make it Friday? Let's do it next week.
scenes.say_native: Rad etganingizdan keyin boshqa vaqtni taklif qilsangiz, siz haqiqatan ham uchrashmoqchi ekaningizni ko‘rsatasiz. How about tomorrow? Ertaga-chi? Are you free on Sunday instead? Buning o‘rniga yakshanba kuni bo‘shmisiz? Can we make it Friday? Juma kuniga qoldirsak bo‘ladimi? Let’s do it next week. Kelasi haftaga qoldiraylik. Make it bu yerda “vaqt belgilash” ma’nosida.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga-chi? Buning o‘rniga yakshanba kuni bo‘shmisiz? Jumaga qoldirsak bo‘ladimi? Kelasi haftaga qoldiraylik.

scenes.title: Javob berish va kelishish
board: Tomorrow's fine. / That works for me.
Let's make it Sunday at six.
scenes.say: That works for me. Sorry, I'm busy then too. Let's make it Sunday at six. So, see you on Sunday!
scenes.say_native: Boshqa vaqt taklif qilinganda ikki javob bor. Mos kelsa: Tomorrow’s fine yoki That works for me, bu menga mos. Mos kelmasa: Sorry, I’m busy then too, va o‘zingiz boshqa vaqtni taklif qiling. Keyin kelishuvni takrorlab tasdiqlang: Let’s make it Sunday at six. So, see you on Sunday! Bunday tasdiq tushunmovchilikdan saqlaydi. Vaqtdan oldin on, at, in ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: Menga mos. Kechirasiz, o‘shanda ham bandman. Yakshanba kuni oltida kelishaylik. Demak, yakshanba kuni ko‘rishamiz!

scenes.title: Vaqt bilan bog‘liq xatolar
board: ✗ See you in Saturday. / at Sunday.
✓ on Saturday, at 7 o’clock, in the evening
scenes.say: Not: in Saturday. Say: on Saturday. Not: on seven o’clock. Say: at seven o’clock.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: in Saturday yoki at Sunday. Hafta kuni oldidan on: on Saturday. Ikkinchisi: on 7 o’clock. Soat oldidan at: at seven o’clock. Kun qismi oldidan in: in the evening. Uchinchisi: noaniq vaqt, maybe sometime yoki we’ll see. Ular aniq vaqt bermaydi, suhbatdosh nima ekanini tushunmaydi. Yaxshisi: How about Sunday at six? Aniq kun va soat ayting.
scenes.say_uz: In Saturday emas, on Saturday deng. On seven o’clock emas, at seven o’clock deng.

scenes.title: Rad eting va yangi vaqt taklif qiling
scenes.say: Refuse and suggest another time. Tonight, tomorrow evening. Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir qatorda chapdagi vaqtga rad eting, o‘ngdagisini taklif qiling. Birinchi: bugun kechqurunga rad, ertaga kechqurunni taklif. Ikkinchi: shanba ertalabga rad, shanba tushdan keyinni taklif. Uchinchi: shu hafta, kelasi hafta. To‘rtinchi: dushanba, chorshanba. Namuna: I’m afraid I can’t tonight. How about tomorrow evening?
scenes.say_uz: Rad eting va boshqa vaqtni taklif qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I'm afraid I can't tonight. How about tomorrow evening?
2) Sorry, I can't in the morning. How about Saturday afternoon?
3) I'm busy this week. Can we make it next week?
4) I can't on Monday. Are you free on Wednesday?
scenes.say: I'm afraid I can't tonight. How about tomorrow evening? I'm busy this week. Can we make it next week?
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: I’m afraid I can’t tonight, how about tomorrow evening? Ikkinchi: Sorry, I can’t in the morning, how about Saturday afternoon? Uchinchi: I’m busy this week, can we make it next week? To‘rtinchi: I can’t on Monday, are you free on Wednesday? Hamma gaplarda bir tuzilma: rad, keyin yangi taklif. Siz ham xuddi shunday qolipda ishlang.
scenes.say_uz: Afsuski, bugun kechqurun qila olmayman. Ertaga kechqurun-chi? Bu hafta bandman. Kelasi haftaga qoldirsak bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bog‘lanish va can't
board: I can't → can't ni aniq ayting
scenes.say: Would you like to come? Would you join us? I can't. I'm afraid I can't.
scenes.say_native: Tez nutqda would you so‘zlari birikib “wudja” kabi eshitiladi: Would you like to come? to‘liq aytilmaydi. To ham zaif, “tə”. Rad etishda can’t so‘zi muhim: Britaniyada kaant, uzun a bilan, Amerikada kænt, qisqa a bilan. Can esa zaif: kən. Can’t va can farqini ovozdan bilish uchun can’t ni aniq va uzunroq ayting, aks holda ma’no teskari tushuniladi.
scenes.say_uz: Kelishni xohlaysizmi? Bizga qo‘shilasizmi? Men qila olmayman. Afsuski, qila olmayman.

scenes.title: Tez ayting
board: 2) Say it fast. How does 'would you' sound?
scenes.say: Say it fast: Would you like to come? How does would you sound? I can't come. I can come.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi gapni tez ayting: would you like to come. Would you so‘zlari qanday eshitildi? Keyin ikki gapni solishtiring: I can’t come va I can come. Qaysisida can aniq va uzun, qaysisida zaif? Ularni baland ovozda ayting. Ma’no farqi faqat can ning kuchida ekanini eshitib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Tez ayting. Would you qanday eshitiladi? Men kela olmayman. Men kela olaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Would you sounds like wudja. I can't come: clear, long a. I can come: weak can.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Would you tez nutqda wudja kabi eshitiladi. I can’t come gapida can’t aniq va uzun aytiladi, urg‘u berilgan. I can come gapida esa can zaif, deyarli kən. Inglizcha so‘zlashuvchi ularni mana shu farq bilan ajratadi. Shuning uchun rad etayotganda can’t ni zaiflashtirmang. Aks holda sizni rozi deb tushunishi mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: Would you wudja kabi eshitiladi. Men kela olmayman: aniq va uzun. Men kela olaman: zaif can.

scenes.title: Yozma taklif va rad javobi
board: Hi Sara, I'm having ... on ... at ...
Would you like to come? Let me know!
Thanks for the invitation! I'd love to, but ...
scenes.say: Hi Sara, I'm having a picnic on Sunday at noon. Would you like to come? Let me know!
scenes.say_native: Yozma taklif qisqa va aniq bo‘ladi. Salomlashing, nima, qachon va qayerda ekanini ayting, keyin taklifni bering, va javob so‘rang: Let me know, menga xabar bering. Rad javobi: Thanks for the invitation, keyin I’d love to, but va sabab, so‘ng boshqa vaqt: How about next week? Oxirida Best wishes yoki See you soon. Do‘stga yozayotganda Hi, rasmiy bo‘lsa Dear bilan boshlang.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Sara, yakshanba kuni tushda piknik qilyapman. Kelishni xohlaysanmi? Menga xabar ber!

scenes.title: Namuna: taklif va rad javobi
board: Taklif: I'm having a picnic on Sunday. Would you like to come?
Javob: Thanks for the invitation! I'd love to, but ...
Sabab: I have to visit my grandmother.
Yangi vaqt: How about next Saturday?
scenes.say: Hi Sara, I'm having a picnic in the park on Sunday at noon. Would you like to come? Let me know! Hi Tom, thanks for the invitation! I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't. I have to visit my grandmother on Sunday. How about next Saturday? Best wishes, Sara.
scenes.say_native: Mana yozma namuna. Birinchi xat taklif: piknik, yakshanba, soat o‘n ikki, park va savol. Ikkinchi xat rad javobi: minnatdorchilik, afsuski qila olmayman, qisqa sabab va yangi vaqt. To‘rtta qadam ko‘rinib turibdi. Siz ham uyga vazifada uchta taklifga uchta shunday rad javobi yozasiz. Shu namunaga suyaning.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Tom, taklif uchun rahmat! Jonim bilan, lekin afsuski, qila olmayman. Yakshanba kuni buvimnikiga borishim kerak. Kelasi shanba-chi? Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Sara.

scenes.title: Siz gapiring
board: Siz: invite your friend to dinner on Friday
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Play both roles. Invite a friend to dinner on Friday. The friend refuses with a reason. Suggest another time. The friend accepts.
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Ikkala rolni o‘zingiz o‘ynaysiz. Avval do‘stingizni juma kuni kechki ovqatga taklif qiling. Keyin do‘stingiz nomidan sabab bilan xushmuomala rad eting. So‘ng boshqa vaqtni taklif qiling va do‘stingiz nomidan rozi bo‘lib, kelishuvni tasdiqlang. Ovoz ohangi o‘zgarishiga e’tibor bering: taklifda xushmuomala, qabulda ishtiyoqli.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Ikkala rolni o‘zingiz o‘ynang. Do‘stingizni taklif qiling, u sabab bilan rad etadi, siz boshqa vaqtni taklif qilasiz, u rozi bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Namuna suhbat
board: A: Would you like to come to dinner on Friday?
B: I'd love to, but I have to work. How about Saturday?
A: Saturday's fine. Let's make it seven.
B: Perfect. Thanks for inviting me!
scenes.say: Would you like to come to dinner on Friday? I'd love to, but I have to work. How about Saturday? Saturday's fine. Let's make it seven. Perfect. Thanks for inviting me!
scenes.say_native: Namuna suhbat. Taklif: Would you like to come to dinner on Friday? Rad: I’d love to, but I have to work. Yangi vaqt: How about Saturday? Qabul: Saturday’s fine. Let’s make it seven. Minnatdorchilik: Thanks for inviting me. Sizning suhbatingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Tekshiring: taklif qolipi, rad etish formulasi, sabab, yangi vaqt va tasdiq bormi? Bo‘lsa, ajoyib.
scenes.say_uz: Juma kuni kechki ovqatga kelishni xohlaysizmi? Jonim bilan, lekin ishlashim kerak. Shanba-chi? Shanba bo‘ladi. Soat yettiga kelishaylik. Zo‘r. Taklif uchun rahmat!

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Would you like to...? / Let's... / How about...?
I'd love to! / That sounds great!
scenes.say: Today you learned how to invite, accept with enthusiasm, refuse politely with a reason, and suggest another time.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Taklif uchun would you like to, do you want to, let’s va how about qoliplarini o‘rgandingiz. Qabul qilish uchun I’d love to va that sounds great, ishtiyoqli ohang bilan. Rad etish formulasi: minnatdorchilik, afsuski qila olmayman, qisqa sabab. Boshqa vaqt taklif qilish uchun how about va can we make it. Kun va soat oldidan on va at ni to‘g‘ri tanlang. Endi siz taklif va rad etishni xushmuomala bajara olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun taklif qilish, ishtiyoq bilan rozi bo‘lish, sabab bilan xushmuomala rad etish va boshqa vaqt taklif qilishni o‘rgandingiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write a polite refusal for each
Thanks + I'm afraid I can't + reason
scenes.say: Your homework: write three invitations and a polite refusal for each one. See you next time!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Uchta taklif yozing: masalan, uchrashuv, ovqat va dam olish uchun. Har biriga xushmuomala rad javobi yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: uchta taklif va uchta rad javobi, har birida minnatdorchilik, sabab have to yoki -ing bilan, kamida ikkitasida boshqa vaqt taklifi. Hammasini ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda buyruq, iltimos va maslahat berishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: uchta taklif va har biriga rad javobi yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Uchta taklif yozing: uchrashuv, ovqat va dam olish uchun. Keyin har biriga xushmuomala rad javobi yozing: avval minnatdorchilik, keyin rad etish, sabab va boshqa vaqt taklifi bilan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: uchta taklif, uchta rad javobi, har birida sabab (have to yoki -ing bilan) va kamida ikkitasida boshqa vaqt taklifi. Hammasini ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.

options: Would you like to come to dinner?
Do you like come to dinner?
Would you like come to dinner?
quiz.why_uz: Would you like to + fe’l: xushmuomala taklif.
Let's dan keyin to yoki -ing siz oddiy fe’l keladi.
Narsa taklifiga qisqa va odobli javob: Yes, please.

quiz.q: 'Would you like to see a film?' Which answer is enthusiastic?
quiz.why_uz: I'd love to! ishtiyoqli va tabiiy javob.

options: I'm afraid I can't. I have to work.
quiz.why_uz: Afsuski + qisqa sabab: xushmuomala rad etish.

quiz.q: I'm afraid I can't. I ___ a meeting at six.
quiz.why_uz: I have a meeting: have bilan, am qo‘shilmaydi.
Hafta kuni oldidan on, soat oldidan at.

quiz.q: You can't come tonight. What can you add?
quiz.why_uz: Aniq boshqa vaqt taklif qilish suhbatni davom ettiradi.

quiz.q: Are you doing anything tonight? What does it ask?
options: What you do for a job
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgi davomli bilan oldindan kelishilgan rejani so‘rayapti.

quiz.q: In British English, 'I can't' is said as:
